data.title: Gen AI Video Startup Runway Raises $315M Led By General Atlantic At ...
data.description:
[Runway](https://www.crunchbase.com/organization/runwayml), an AI research and technology startup, said Tuesday that it has raised $315 million in a Series E round of funding.

The capital was raised at a $5.3 billion valuation, up from $3.3 billion at the time of its [$308 million Series D](https://news.crunchbase.com/ai/image-startup-unicorn-runway-general-atlantic/) round last April, which was also led by General Atlantic.

In total, the New York-based startup has raised $860 million since its 2018 inception.

## Background and present
On 3 April 2025, Runway raised $308 million in a funding round led by [General Atlantic](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/General_Atlantic), valuing it at over $3 billion.

In February 2026, Runway raised $315 million at a reported valuation of $5.3 billion.
